name: unchained_berserker_blocks_a_white_attacker_and_takes_no_damage_from_it
notes: Printed: 'Protection from white (This creature can't be ... dealt damage ... by anything white.)'. Protection does not stop the Berserker blocking: on seat 1's turn a white 2/2 attacks and the Berserker blocks it. The white creature's combat damage to the Berserker is prevented (no damage on it, it survives), and the Berserker, not attacking, deals only its 1 to the attacker.
